content: GODAY tana, «Isra7eele asay hara xoossatakko simmidi zabibe ukeththi shiishshana koyides; hessarakka GODAY istta siiqizayssa mala nekka baada ba laggeththota siiqada laymatashe diza kase ne machcheyo zaarada siiqa» gides.
Hessa gishshas ta izo tammanne ichchashu saqile biraninne 150 kilo banggan shammadis.
Ta izo, «Ne laymatizayssanne hara as kaallizayssa aggada tanara daro wode xilloteththan de7a; tanikka nenara ammaneteththan daana» ga zoradis.

Hessaththoka Isra7eele asay kawoy baynda woykko kaaleththizaadey baynda, yarshoy baynda woykko eeqa xoossata hawultey baynda, qeeseteththa may7oy baynda woykko eeqa xoossata misley baynda daro wode de7ana.
Hessafe guye Isra7eele derey GODAA ba Xoossaakonne ba kawo Dawitekko simmana. Wurseththa wode istti yashshan kokkorishe GODAAKKONNE iza anjjoko yaana.
